lines.text: Anthropic's AI writes so much code that Git could not keep up, so they built Scion.
Merged changes grew from about 2,500 a day in May to more than 30,000 a day by September.
lines.title: Code changes per day

lines.text: Automated systems do about 25 million checkouts a day. Each one copies a version of the code to a worker.
lines.title: Checkouts

lines.text: With Git, every worker keeps its own big copy. Anthropic ran several hundred mirror servers to share them.
lines.title: Sharing code

lines.text: A job asks a local helper first. If it misses, it asks a regional cache, then the main servers.
lines.title: Layers of cache

lines.text: Files are named by a fingerprint of their contents, so the same name always means the same data.
lines.title: Content-addressing

lines.text: When AI writes code fast, the tools that store and share code must scale too.
lines.title: Takeaways
